text:
Alice Gomez: FYI customer CUST-842 opened a ticket — they're getting 429s starting ~09:10 UTC but the Quota panel shows plenty of units left. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/CUST-842 :confused:
Ben (support): can you paste an example request_id and timestamp? helps correlate with enforcer logs
Alice Gomez: request_id=rid_0a7c3f, timestamp=2026-02-18T09:12:04Z. Console screenshot attached in ticket, panel shows Available: 12,000 tokens.
Ryan Analytics: checked ingestion stream around that window — we saw a spike in CDC lag. quota-aggregator lag peaked ~8m, a number of updates didn't make it to the metrics store. :eyes:
Carmen SRE: if aggregator isn't publishing, enforcer may be using stale local counters and still return 429s. can someone share enforcer logs for rid_0a7c3f?
Zoe Oncall: repro steps: run this curl against customer org key to get 429 locally:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer org-CUST-842-key"
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}' -i
```
Response headers show: `x-enforcer-reason: quota_exceeded_local` and HTTP 429 body.
Ben (support): grabbing enforcer logs now, tailing pods in us-west-2-enforcer. status: one enforcer pod had a 1m restart at 09:08 UTC.
deploy-bot: replay-job queued: quota-aggregator-replay job/agg-replay-193765 triggered by Ben (support) — ETA ~20m
Ryan Analytics: quick query I ran (timeseries DB):
```
SELECT max(ingest_lag_seconds) FROM quota_ingest WHERE org='CUST-842' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-18T09:00' AND '2026-02-18T09:30'; -- result: 480
```
lag ~= 8 minutes. several commit messages show schema migration stalled and CDC connector paused.
Carmen SRE: root cause: CDC connector paused by schema drift, aggregator backlog meant console panels didn't get the latest counts; enforcer still used last known (lower) count and enforced 429s. short-term mitigation: enable `enforcer.use_fallback_global_counts=true` to let enforcer consult coarse global counters until aggregator catches up. I'll roll the flag to canary in us-west. :thumbsup:
Alice Gomez: ETA on the flag roll? need to tell customer what to expect.
Carmen SRE: rolling in 2m to 3 pods now, will confirm when all canaries pass. following with a full rollout in 15m if health good.
Ben (support): I'll update ticket CUST-842: explain transient backend ingestion lag, suggest client retry/backoff, and say we expect fix within ~20m.
Zoe Oncall: once flag is live I'll monitor error rate for that org and post a short summary here.
Ryan Analytics: after the earlier replay job finishes, I'll backfill missing events and trigger dashboard refresh. expected full console parity within 40-60m.
Alice Gomez: thanks — please ping when console shows counts aligned and we can close the ticket.
